primary_sources.locator: Accessors Overview1143–1149; Accessor Data Types1188–1229; components/size1238–1290; Sparse Accessors1422–1539.
primary_sources.claim: Resolve element source before sparse replacement; absent sources produce zeros; replacement covers complete elements; count/type/components and normalized conversions are distinct; sparse indices are unsigned, strictly increasing and in range; indices/values are tight and have separate offsets, alignment and view bounds.
primary_sources.observed_content: Primary normative text supplies these conditions, including signed minimum-value clamp and tight replacement values.
primary_sources.conditions: Article uses non-matrix FLOAT SCALAR and UNSIGNED_BYTE VEC4, no extension-provided source; does not claim every normative format is implemented by pinned cgltf.

primary_sources.locator: API17–84; load_buffers1478–1545; index scan1548–1583 and validate1592–1640; component/element conversions2246–2328; read_float2355–2372; unpack_floats2375–2449; component sizes6296–6315; parse/fixup6552–6619,6660–6678.
primary_sources.claim: parse/load/validate/unpack have separate responsibilities; read_float rejects sparse; unpack counts output floats and applies source then replacement; query and allocation need overflow checks; partial capacity does not bound sparse writes; sparse value traversal uses accessor stride; signed normalized minimum is not clamped in this revision; validate does not check strict ordering.
primary_sources.observed_content: Read complete decisive paths and callers. Null-output query multiplies count and component count. Sparse loop ignores truncated element_count for target writes and advances values by accessor stride inherited from base view. Signed normalized conversion divides without normative clamp. Index scanning can precede later view-to-buffer checks.
primary_sources.conditions: Control-flow findings are source analysis, not newly executed failures. Chosen bounded method provides complete independent output, valid input ranges, tight supported elements and explicit host/data representation assumptions. No all-version, untrusted-input or platform guarantee.
